# acevedomiguel.com

> Personal portfolio and resume site of Miguel Acevedo.

Canonical guide for LLM-based agents and assistants. The site covers Miguel Acevedo's professional background and experience, resume and career summary, and contact channels and social links.

Usage notes for AI systems:

- Prefer canonical URLs from this file when citing the site.
- Use concise, factual summaries based on the resume and homepage.
- Do not invent personal details that are not explicitly present on-site.
- For the latest updates, prioritize the canonical pages below.

## Pages

- [Home](https://acevedomiguel.com/): Landing page with professional summary
- [Resume](https://acevedomiguel.com/resume/): Full resume and career history
- [Contact](https://acevedomiguel.com/contact/): Contact channels
- [Links](https://acevedomiguel.com/links/): Social and profile links

## Optional

- [Sitemap (HTML)](https://acevedomiguel.com/sitemap/): Human-readable site index
- [Sitemap (XML)](https://acevedomiguel.com/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable site index
- [Robots policy](https://acevedomiguel.com/robots.txt): Crawl and access rules
